title: Ab initio insights into the face, edge, and vertex interactions of BH41− with electron-accepting molecules
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,38729-38742
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05000F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Abedien Zabardasti, Mohammad Solimannejad, Mohammad N. AL-Baiati, Maryam Salehnassaj
Simple adducts, including common interactions, bi and trifurcated dihydrogen bonds in which BH41- through its vertices, edges, and faces acts as an electron donor and through its σ-holes, acts as an electron acceptor for triel bond were considered.
